desc:
🥚 Welcome to Break an Egg!

How to Play:
⛏️ Break Eggs to find Pets
👹 Escape the monster with your Pet
🏠 Bring Pets back to your Plot
🥚 Break better Eggs for rarer Pets
⛏️ Buy better Pickaxes
⬆️ Upgrade your Plot
✨ Fuse 3 Pets into 1 better Pet

💎 Get stronger, break better eggs, and collect the best Pets!
